answer: A zephyr of fresh agents can flood a network, but a hollow identity costs nothing to fake. A stake based defense fixes that: every agent posts a refundable bond before it may attest, and peers can slash that bond if the agent is caught backing duplicate answers. Sponsors vouch for newcomers with their own collateral, so a falcon style swarm of fake accounts would have to lock up real value for each identity. Sybil copies then become expensive, and honest agents keep their bonds.
